SYS-REQ-001.title: RAG Output Faithfulness
SYS-REQ-001.description: The system shall generate answers where ≥ 80% of claims are supported by retrieved context, as measured by FaithfulnessMetric.

SYS-REQ-002.title: RAG Answer Relevance
SYS-REQ-002.description: Generated answers shall directly address the question asked, achieving AnswerRelevancyMetric ≥ 0.75.

SYS-REQ-003.title: Out-of-Context Refusal
SYS-REQ-003.description: When the document corpus contains no relevant information, the system shall acknowledge uncertainty rather than fabricate an answer.

SYS-REQ-004.title: Prompt Regression Prevention
SYS-REQ-004.description: Quality metric scores shall not degrade more than 10% from the established baseline following any model, prompt, or corpus change.

SYS-REQ-005.title: BOM Schema and Business Rule Compliance
SYS-REQ-005.description: Bill of Materials records shall conform to the defined schema: valid part number format, positive unit costs, recognised categories and classification codes.

SYS-REQ-006.title: Supplier Data Validity
SYS-REQ-006.description: Supplier records shall be complete and within valid ranges: risk score 0–100, on-time delivery rate 0.0–1.0, audit year within acceptable window.

SYS-REQ-007.title: BOM–Supplier Referential Integrity
SYS-REQ-007.description: Every supplier_id referenced in the BOM shall exist in the supplier register. Orphaned BOM records are not permitted.

SYS-REQ-008.title: ITAR Export Control Compliance
SYS-REQ-008.description: SECRET-classified components shall not be sourced from non-US suppliers. Any such data configuration shall be flagged as a compliance violation.

SYS-REQ-009.title: Vector Index Dimensional Integrity
SYS-REQ-009.description: The FAISS index dimensionality shall match the configured embedding model output dimension (384 for all-MiniLM-L6-v2). A mismatch shall fail validation.

SYS-REQ-010.title: Retrieval Accuracy
SYS-REQ-010.description: Known queries shall retrieve chunks from the correct source document as the top result. Out-of-domain queries shall return similarity scores indicating low relevance.

SYS-REQ-011.title: BOM Value Plausibility
SYS-REQ-011.description: The aggregate Bill of Materials value shall fall within the expected programme budget range ($100,000–$100,000,000). Values outside this range indicate data corruption.

SYS-REQ-012.title: Supplier Audit Timeliness
SYS-REQ-012.description: All active suppliers shall have been audited within the last two years. Suppliers with audits older than 2023 shall be flagged as non-compliant.

SYS-REQ-013.title: Supply Chain Diversification
SYS-REQ-013.description: No part category shall be sole-sourced from a supplier with risk score > 50. Single-source high-risk dependencies shall be flagged as policy violations.

SYS-REQ-014.title: RBAC Enforcement
SYS-REQ-014.description: Every API endpoint shall enforce role-based access control. Each role shall receive exactly the HTTP status codes defined in the access matrix — 200 for permitted, 401 for unauthenticated, 403 for unauthorised.

SYS-REQ-015.title: API PII Redaction
SYS-REQ-015.description: Endpoints accessible to lower-privilege roles shall not expose PII (email, phone, SSN) in response bodies or error messages. PII shall only be returned to roles explicitly granted contact:read or users:read permission.

SYS-REQ-016.title: LLM PII Prevention
SYS-REQ-016.description: The RAG pipeline shall not produce PII in generated outputs when queried with PII-fishing prompts. The model shall respond with a refusal rather than hallucinating personal contact details.
